subject: Slow data speeds in downtown area
description: Customer reports significantly slower data speeds (under 5 Mbps) in the downtown financial district during business hours. Started about a week ago.

subject: Unexpected overage charges
description: Customer was charged $35 in overage fees despite having an unlimited plan. Questions appear to be related to hotspot usage exceeding 30GB cap.

subject: Cannot access online account
description: Customer unable to log into their account portal. Password reset emails not being received. Suspects email on file may be incorrect.
resolution: Updated email address on file and verified customer identity. Sent new password reset link. Customer confirmed access restored.

subject: Cannot send MMS messages
description: Family plan primary account holder unable to send picture messages. Affects two lines on the account.

subject: Want to add international roaming
description: Business customer planning travel to Europe next month. Needs international roaming package added to account for 2 weeks.
